title: SCHC sender start drops all initial fragments after the first
description: Correctness review: FragmentSender.start() returns only _fragments[0] for a multi-fragment packet, so the public API never exposes the remaining initial regular fragments or All-1. It also sets attempts=1 before All-1 is sent. Emit or expose the complete ordered authenticated initial batch; count Attempts only when All-1 is transmitted; verify canonical fragmentation vectors byte-for-byte.
